interpreted_intent: Create one independent complex fashion photograph that tests the gathered-waist, dropped-seat, voluminous-leg, and gathered-ankle structure of harem trousers while using the attached portrait only as an adult appearance reference.
subject: A clearly adult woman whose visible hair, eyes, makeup, and calm expression are guided by the attached portrait.
setting: A dawn vinyl market beneath a concrete rail viaduct after summer rain.
event: She lifts one record from a crate while stepping across a shallow puddle.
visual_priorities: The trouser volume begins at a gathered waistband, drops through a roomy seat and crotch, and converges into narrow gathered ankle cuffs.
The full-body diagonal stance keeps waist, crotch drape, both outer-leg contours, cuffs, and footwear legible.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a full-body 40 mm editorial photograph at a dawn vinyl market beneath a concrete rail viaduct after summer rain. A clearly adult woman with long dark center-parted softly waved hair, warm brown eyes, natural makeup, and a calm expression is guided only by the visible appearance in the attached portrait. She lifts one record from a crate while stepping across a shallow puddle. She wears a fitted graphite halter top and lightweight olive harem trousers with a fully gathered waistband, dropped roomy seat, deep crotch drape, pronounced hip-and-thigh volume, continuous loose folds, and narrow gathered ankle cuffs. Keep the waist, crotch drape, both curved outer-leg contours, cuffs, and translucent jelly sandals unobstructed. Amber stall bulbs, hand-lettered price cards, stacked sleeves, concrete reflections, and a tiny silver bag charm build visual complexity around the silhouette without covering it.
